title: MaintenancePlugin
description: Lightweight maintenance mode plugin with GUI, timer, whitelist & LuckPerms support for Paper 1.16–1.21.x
body:
# 🔧 Maintenance
**by Alomeric | v1.0.0 | Paper & Spigot 1.16 – 1.21.x**

Put your server into maintenance mode with a single command – no restarts needed.

---

## ✨ Features
- **Maintenance Toggle** – Enable or disable instantly via command or GUI
- **Player Whitelist** – Allow specific players to join during maintenance
- **Custom Kick Message** – Color codes & line breaks supported
- **Maintenance MOTD** – Custom server list message while active
- **Countdown Timer** – Timed activation with automatic announcements
- **Interactive GUI** – Manage everything in a clean 27-slot inventory menu
- **LuckPerms Support** – Native integration with automatic Bukkit fallback
- **Bilingual (EN / DE)** – Switch between English and German in config.yml
- **Config Overrides** – Override any message directly in config.yml

---

## 📋 Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/mt on` / `/mt off` | Enable / disable maintenance mode |
| `/mt toggle` | Toggle maintenance mode |
| `/mt status` | Show current status |
| `/mt timer <seconds>` | Start a countdown timer |
| `/mt timer stop` | Cancel the running timer |
| `/mt whitelist add/remove <player>` | Manage the whitelist |
| `/mt whitelist list` | Show all whitelisted players |
| `/mt setmsg <text>` | Set the kick message |
| `/mt setmotd <text>` | Set the server MOTD |
| `/mt gui` | Open the inventory GUI |
| `/mt reload` | Reload config & language file |

---

## 🔑 Permissions
| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `maintenance.admin` | OP | Access to all commands |
| `maintenance.bypass` | OP | Bypass maintenance – can always join |

> Permission nodes are fully customizable in `config.yml`.

---

## 📦 Installation
1. Drop `Maintenance-1.0.0.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Start or restart your server
3. Configure `plugins/Maintenance/config.yml` as needed
4. Use `/mt reload` to apply changes without restarting

---

## 🌍 Language Support
English is the default. Switch to German by setting `language: de` in `config.yml`.
All messages are fully editable in `plugins/Maintenance/lang/`.

---
